newsitem.title: INDIA: Speculators drive Delhi shares to a higher close.
newsitem.headline: Speculators drive Delhi shares to a higher close.

text.p: Delhi shares ended higher in brisk trade on Tuesday as speculators made heavy purchases on hopes that the government would soon follow through on its promised package to revive capital markets, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's sensitive index closed 6.38 points higher at 767.91.

"The prime minister's statement came as a shot in the arm for speculators who indulged in frenzied buying, forcing bears to stay on the sidelines," said Suresh Aggarwal of brokers Jai Mata Securities.

Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda on Monday told a group of industrialists in Bombay that his government would stick to the economic policy of the previous government and that steps would be announced this week to create a better investment climate.
Reliance Industries was in the spotlight as its shares surged 9.50 rupees to 282.50 on foreign buying coupled with purchases by speculators, brokers said.
TISCO gained 5.25 rupees to 212.50 on institutional buying.
State Bank of India soared 18.15 rupees to 313.90.
